title: 1RB1RE_1RC0RF_0LD---_1LE1LD_1RA0LB_0RE1LC: no halt in 1.90·10<sup>13</sup> steps
text: The block accelerator follows the growth phase after the fourth hand-over: the left zone grows to about 606,000 copies, eats the irregular stretch of about 1.36 million cells and then starts on the block of 5-cell words. At 1.68·10<sup>13</sup> steps the right tail of the tape, unchanged since before 5·10<sup>11</sup>, starts to grow.
